Sandbox_QoLC_AdrenalineEnabled_tooltip: Panic temporarily takes fatigue off the character, hiding the Tired debuff until they calm down.
Sandbox_QoLC_AdrenalineBoostSpeed_toolti: How quickly panic wakes the character up. Higher sheds the Tired debuff sooner.
Sandbox_QoLC_AdrenalineCrashSpeed_toolti: How quickly drowsiness returns once the character calms down.
Sandbox_QoLC_AdrenalineCrashPenalty_tool: How much extra fatigue is paid back on top of what adrenaline borrowed.
Sandbox_QoLC_PropanePumpCost_tooltip: Fuel drawn from a pump to fill one propane tank. A jerry can holds 10, a pump holds 22000.
Sandbox_QoLC_TailoringCutXpEnabled_toolt: Cutting a garment into strips teaches tailoring, and cutting gets quicker as the skill rises. Vanilla pays nothing for either.
Sandbox_QoLC_TailoringCutXp_tooltip: Percentage of the experience a cut garment is worth. Denim and leather pay per strip, cotton pays nothing, uniforms pay a bonus on top.
Sandbox_QoLC_AlarmHouseRule_tooltip: Stops a house alarm sounding for a house anyone could already have walked into. Unlocked doors covers many more houses than open ones, since vanilla leaves most exterior doors unlocked.
Sandbox_QoLC_AlarmVehiclesEnabled_toolti: Stops a car alarm sounding when a door or the trunk was left unlocked, a door or window stands open, or a window has been smashed out.
